# Soham Singh

> Soham Singh is a second-year B.Tech Information Technology student at Netaji Subhash Engineering College (NSEC), Kolkata, building privacy-first AI and backend systems. He is seeking software, AI, and backend engineering internships.

Key facts:
- Role: software engineering student; backend and AI systems.
- Location: Kolkata, West Bengal, India (IST / UTC+5:30).
- Focus: privacy-first AI, local inference, backend architecture, supervisory analytics.
- Contact: https://sohamsingh.indevs.in/contact · sohamsingh572@gmail.com · https://github.com/Som007-builds · https://www.linkedin.com/in/soham-singh-a21688307/

## Featured projects

- [Foretyx / Arbiter](https://sohamsingh.indevs.in/systems#foretyx): a policy-aware privacy gateway that makes the decision to share data with a model explicit and inspectable. Design and feasibility stage; no public source.
- [Axion](https://sohamsingh.indevs.in/systems#axion): a claim-level knowledge graph that turns research papers into inspectable claims, evidence, contradictions, and research gaps. Working prototype. Source: https://github.com/Som007-builds/Axion
- [Orion](https://sohamsingh.indevs.in/systems#orion): an air-gapped SOC supervisory analytics platform that produces evidence-linked hypotheses. Smart India Hackathon 2026 (problem statement 26157). Source: https://github.com/Som007-builds/orion
- [Indigent](https://sohamsingh.indevs.in/systems#indigent): a sovereign, local-first agentic workbench with a policy-validated tool loop and a Docker sandbox. Smart India Hackathon 2026 (problem statement 26117). Source: https://github.com/Som007-builds/indigent-dev
